name: blyx-linearfit
description: Fit single-feature and bilinear regression models in Blyx. Includes factored-matrix training, predictions, source and starter projects.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with LinearFit
walkthroughs.description: Fit single-feature and bilinear regression models in Blyx. Includes factored-matrix training, predictions, source and starter projects.

steps.title: Run the LinearFit example
steps.description:
Create an empty .blyx file, insert blyx-linearfit-demo and choose **Blyx: Run File**.
[Open the documentation](https://www.blyx-lang.space/packages/linearfit)

steps.title: Train a factored matrix
steps.description:
Extract the starter. With the documented compiler revision installed, run the scale example task.
[Open the experiment](https://www.blyx-lang.space/articles/training-in-factors)
